info.title: API.SH: OffPlan Insider
info.description: The OffPlan Insider API from API.SH: public OffPlan Insider data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One off-plan project page of OffPlan Insider (offplaninsider.com/projects/<slug>/): name, developer, emirate and area, latitude and longitude when the page gives them, description, number of homes, unit types summary, starting price (or price on request), handover, the date it was last verified, key facts, the price list by unit type (size, price from, price per sq ft, availability), the payment plan with its milestones and calculator figures, floor plan unit types, image gallery, amenities, location text with drive times, the developer profile (stats, registration), the site's own take (what it likes, what to weigh), similar projects to compare, FAQ, breadcrumbs, every page section's heading and text, plus `raw` with the page's structured data. An unknown slug answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/offplaninsider-project

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The project slug from /offplaninsider/v1/projects (e.g. berkeley-square-by-prestige-one-jvc) or the project page link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The UAE off-plan project directory of OffPlan Insider (offplaninsider.com/projects/): every development it tracks across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, Sharjah, Umm Al Quwain, Ajman and Fujairah. Each project has its name, slug and page link, developer, emirate, community/area, property types, starting price in AED (null when the price is on request), budget band, handover date and year (or to be confirmed), booking percentage, post-handover and 1%-monthly plan flags, launch status, buyer goals, waterfront and branded-residence flags, a highlight line, cover image and thumbnail, plus `raw`. Filter by emirate, developer, area, property type, budget band, price range, handover year, payment plan, status, buyer goal, features or free text, and sort by price, handover or name. The response also lists every filter value with its project count (`filters`: developers and areas included). Pages: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Pass a project's `slug` to /offplaninsider/v1/project for its full page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/offplaninsider-projects

parameters.name: emirate
parameters.description: Only projects in these emirates (comma-separated slugs or names): dubai, abu-dhabi, ras-al-khaimah, sharjah, umm-al-quwain, ajman, fujairah.

parameters.name: developer
parameters.description: Developer slug or name (comma-separated for several), e.g. emaar-properties or Sobha. A slug or full name matches exactly; other text matches any developer whose name contains it.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Community / area slug or name (comma-separated for several), e.g. jumeirah-village-circle or Dubai Marina; other text matches any area whose name contains it.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Property types (comma-separated; a project matches when it has any of them): apartment, villa, townhouse, penthouse, duplex, branded-residence, serviced-apartment, commercial, plot.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Budget bands (comma-separated): under-1m-aed, 1m-2m-aed, 2m-3m-aed, 3m-5m-aed, 5m-10m-aed, 10m-20m-aed, over-20m-aed.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum starting price in AED (e.g. 1500000 or 1.5M). Projects priced on request are left out when a price bound is set.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum starting price in AED (e.g. 3000000 or 3M).

parameters.name: handover_year
parameters.description: Handover years (comma-separated), e.g. 2027, or tbc for projects without a confirmed date.

parameters.name: payment_plan
parameters.description: Payment plan features (comma-separated; any of them): post-handover (part paid after the keys), 1-percent-monthly, low-booking (10% or less on booking).

parameters.name: max_booking_percent
parameters.description: Only projects whose booking payment is at most this percentage (projects without a known booking share are left out).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Launch status (comma-separated): launch (new launch), pre (pre-launch), build (under construction / selling), ready (ready or near handover).

parameters.name: goal
parameters.description: Buyer goals (comma-separated): capital-growth, rental-income, golden-visa, family-home, first-time-buyers, short-term-rental.

parameters.name: waterfront
parameters.description: true for waterfront projects only, false to leave them out.

parameters.name: branded
parameters.description: true for branded residences only, false to leave them out.

parameters.name: priced
parameters.description: true for projects with a published starting price only, false for projects priced on request only.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text matched against project, developer, area and emirate names.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: default (the site's own order), price_asc, price_desc, handover (soonest first), handover_desc, booking_asc (smallest booking payment first), name. Projects without the sorted value come last.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Projects per page (default 50, up to 1000).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
